categories.main_business_segments: Horng Shiue Holding Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of automotive body sheet metal molds and inspection fixtures. The company focuses on automotive sheet metal molds including body covering molds, inner sheet metal molds, and structural molds, which are critical for automotive manufacturing. Over 90% of its revenue derives from automotive body sheet metal mold production, with the remainder from scrap material sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced stamping mold design and manufacturing technologies, including unique structural design techniques to improve production efficiency and product quality. It integrates CAE/CAD/CAM technologies for digital design and manufacturing, uses high-speed precision machining, composite processing, and intelligent forming technologies. The firm also develops molds for new materials like aluminum alloys to meet lightweight automotive trends and applies digital simulation and knowledge engineering for mold lifecycle management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Horng Shiue serves major automotive manufacturers, including international mainstream OEMs such as Ford and Volvo, as well as leading Chinese automakers like Geely, BYD, and Chery. Its products cater to both domestic Chinese automotive markets and export markets, with a strong focus on new energy vehicles. The company’s customers are primarily automotive OEMs requiring high-precision, customized stamping molds for vehicle body parts.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with key manufacturing subsidiaries located in Shanghai and Zhejiang provinces. It also has a holding company registered in the Cayman Islands and a Taiwan office. Its sales are predominantly domestic within China (about 89% of revenue), with the remainder from exports outside China. The company is expanding its global footprint by targeting international markets and cooperating with overseas automotive manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Horng Shiue operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, specializing in the design and manufacturing of automotive stamping molds and inspection fixtures. It supplies critical tooling equipment to downstream automotive OEMs for vehicle body production. The company collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream vehicle manufacturers to ensure product integration and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with continuous R&D investment exceeding 1% of sales revenue annually. Strategic focuses include digitalization and smart manufacturing integration, development of molds for new lightweight materials like aluminum alloys, and enhancement of mold precision and production efficiency. It aims to upgrade management systems, promote green manufacturing, and deepen industry chain collaboration to support new energy vehicle market growth and global expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Horng Shiue generates revenue primarily through customized product sales of automotive sheet metal molds and related inspection fixtures. Revenue recognition occurs over long-term contracts spanning 1-2 years from order signing to final acceptance. Additional minor revenue streams include sales of scrap materials. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but on project-based manufacturing contracts with automotive OEMs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with several key Chinese automotive mold manufacturers such as Tianjin Automotive Mold (Tianqi Mo), Chengfei Integration, Ruihu Mold, Yisen, Yifeng, and Xingda. It positions itself as a leading mid-to-high-end mold supplier with a market share around 1% in China’s RMB 55 billion automotive stamping mold market. Horng Shiue focuses on high-precision, high-value molds and maintains stable partnerships with international OEMs, distinguishing itself from low-end competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, Horng Shiue reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.91 billion, a 14.14% increase year-over-year, and a net profit of NT$16.7 million reversing prior losses. The company’s total assets are around NT$3.22 billion with equity of NT$744 million, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability. Cash flow from operations significantly increased, supporting ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The firm is in a growth phase, leveraging China’s expanding automotive market and new energy vehicle trends.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Horng Shiue emphasizes its advanced technical capabilities in mold design and manufacturing, including proprietary structural designs that enhance production efficiency and product quality. It offers one-stop services from design to mass production, ensuring high precision and reliability tailored to customer specifications. The company’s strong R&D focus, integration of digital and smart manufacturing technologies, and experience with new materials like aluminum alloys provide competitive differentiation. Long-term stable relationships with major OEMs and a commitment to quality and innovation underpin its value proposition.
